verdict.rationale: Llama ships dedicated safety-classifier models — Prompt Guard (benign/injection/jailbreak classifier meant to run as a pre-LLM filter) and Llama Guard 3 (input/output safeguard model) — which are concrete, documented guardrail primitives for gating model output before it acts. However these are open-weight models requiring self-hosting rather than a managed moderation API/endpoint, and there's no first-party 'moderation endpoint' service comparable to hosted providers. missing for 10: a hosted/managed moderation API, independent hands-on validation that Llama Guard/Prompt Guard reliably block unsafe output in production, and clearer integration docs beyond model cards.
